daily.today_energy: Your vibe is grounded but quietly electric. The cosmos is nudging you toward authenticity—stop performing and start *being*. Trust that your natural rhythm is exactly what the universe ordered.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the real you beneath the armor. Whether single or coupled, this is your moment to drop the guard just enough to let connection breathe. Vulnerability looks good on you today.
daily.career: Your ideas have momentum right now—the kind that doesn't need validation to feel solid. Channel that inner knowing into something tangible. Your work speaks louder than words ever could.
daily.health: Your body's asking for presence over perfection. A walk, some water, honest rest—the simple stuff hits different when you're actually *there* for it. Tune in instead of tuning out.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is inviting you to soften your edges, cap. You've been grinding hard, and the cosmos is gently suggesting it's time to let people in. Trust the unfolding.
